project_type: macOS menu bar app (Swift, SwiftPM, AppKit lifecycle)
language: Swift 6.0 toolchain, LedgeCore target uses language mode 6, Ledge target uses language mode 5
build_system: SwiftPM + custom Makefile for bundling/codesigning. Ledge executable only builds on macOS (#if os(macOS) in Package.swift). Only LedgeCore compiles on Linux.
test_framework: swift-testing framework (not XCTest). 54 tests in LedgeCoreTests. Tests run on Linux.
build_command: swift build (only builds LedgeCore on Linux; full app only on macOS via `make app`)
verification_instructions: Run `swift test` and confirm all 54 LedgeCore tests pass. The Ledge target cannot be compiled on Linux - only verify Swift syntax is reasonable via code review.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - Swift 6.2.1 is pre-installed on this Linux sandbox. `swift test` runs the LedgeCore tests directly.
environment_constraints: Linux sandbox - cannot compile Ledge target (macOS-only AppKit/SwiftUI). Cannot verify SwiftUI code compiles. Mark uncertain SwiftUI API usage with // UNVERIFIED: comments. OPEN_INTERNET network mode.
contribution_requirements: Commit with git -c user.name=TuyenNedd -c user.email=90548508+TuyenNedd@users.noreply.github.com. All output in English. Do not push or create PRs.
key_patterns: AppKit lifecycle via main.swift (NSApplication.shared, global AppDelegate). Windows created as NSWindow with manual view setup (see DiagnosticsWindow.swift pattern). Preferences is a final class wrapping UserDefaults with Key enum. GestureController owns the engine and wires callbacks. MenuBarController uses NSMenu with target-action pattern. Status item uses SF Symbols with template image.
directory_structure: Sources/LedgeCore/ - platform-independent gesture logic (6 files). Sources/Ledge/ - macOS app layer (11 files currently). Tests/LedgeCoreTests/ - 54 tests. Resources/ - Info.plist. docs/ - DESIGN.md and plans/. dist/ - build output (gitignored).
